Asset metadata reports expired and new authorized download/range requests are denied

cases.name: Cancellation winning before completion prevents later publication
semanticViolations: CANCEL_COMPLETE_RACE: cancellation guard committed first for this job
cases.expectedServiceOutcome: Reject stale completion write even if its JSON shape is valid; stop execution then finalize cancellation.

cases.name: Late cancellation after a reclaim cannot refund prior render work
semanticViolations: QUOTA_SETTLEMENT: execution-after-render-reclaim.valid.json records a prior actual render start, but cancellation settlement released its reservation
cases.expectedServiceOutcome: Consume the single slot once after confirmed stop; keep the first render-start marker across attempts.

cases.name: Replaying a receipt does not re-run capacity checks or reserve twice
semanticExpectations: Same owner/action/key/method/target/body within 24 hours returns the original receipt even if worker now offline
Another body or concrete target with the same scoped key returns 409
cases.expectedServiceOutcome: No new job or reservation; current HTTP tracing metadata is regenerated outside the immutable admission data receipt.

cases.name: A repeated terminal reservation settlement cannot count twice
semanticExpectations: Second settlement of the same reserved-to-consumed outcome is idempotent
A conflicting consumed-to-released update is rejected by the transaction/ledger guard

cases.name: Duration mismatch is a nonretryable pipeline failure
Known nonretryable duration failure cannot create a same-snapshot retry
semanticViolations: A NEW retry is requested even though error.retryable=false and revision is required
cases.expectedServiceOutcome: 409 GENERATION_NOT_RETRYABLE; no new job/reservation; revise and approve a new draft. Matching authenticated original receipt replay creates no work and remains allowed.

cases.name: Known revision-required snapshot cannot bypass retry guard via new start
semanticViolations: Referenced approved snapshot has known unresolved duration-revision failure
cases.expectedServiceOutcome: 409 REVISION_REQUIRED for fresh admission; matching original receipt may replay without reservation.

cases.name: Pre-cancel render evidence can arrive after cancellation accepted
cases.expectedServiceOutcome: Evidence-only update; no launch/resume/publication. Confirm stop before consuming once.

cases.name: Post-cancel launch is not legitimate pre-cancel render evidence
semanticViolations: renderStartedAt is after accepted cancelRequestedAt; cannot claim it as pre-cancel execution
cases.expectedServiceOutcome: Reject evidence classification; no new work or false pre-cancel charge. Stop any unauthorized process; uncertain process state stays pending.
